differences: Shell fur is left out: glTF has no shells, so the skin shows only the coat's mean colour and roughness (the engine must grow its own fur)
Light wrapping round the skin is left out, so engines show a harder edge between light and shadow
Breathing (a 1% swell of the chest) is left out of the idle clip
Fine surface detail that fades with distance is approximated: it is baked at the texel size and only mipmaps fade it
